key_insight: Medi-Gemma combines deterministic EMR analytics with retrieval-augmented generation to reduce hallucinations and keep clinical answers grounded in structured patient data.
clinical_relevance: It is designed as a safer clinical decision support workflow for wound pathology triage and EMR-driven automation, where traceable and rule-based outputs matter.
method: DataManager cleans EMR files and routes structured queries to PandasQueryEngine
ClinicalRAGEngine handles patient-specific reasoning with a CPU-optimized vector store and ground-truth injection
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation showing improved factual adherence, elimination of semantic context drift, and fewer backend database compilation crashes.
watch_item: The architecture still depends on correct routing, reliable phrase filters, and high-quality structured data, so implementation errors could affect safety and consistency.
paper_title: Medi-Gemma: A Hybrid Clinical Decision Support System Integrating Deterministic EMR Analytics and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
